name: rigid
description: A body of rigid pieces that move against each other (a turret, a drone, a walking machine, a weapon with moving parts, a chest with a lid): one root bone at the pivot; the model adds every moving piece's bone (extra_bones) and pins each part to one bone (FIXED). Sides L and R expand '{s}' in the model's data for paired pieces.

about.parts: No default binding: every part of a rigid body is pinned to the bone it moves with through the model's FIXED, so no part takes blended weights.
about.roll: Every bone's Z axis points forward (-Y) at rest, as the biped's; a model bone may give its own roll.
about.poses: None: the moving pieces are the model's own bones, so the model gives its review poses (POSES) and its test pose.
